testcase.name: all six authoritative dice faces settle facing up
hop starts and ends on the actual tile, with eased endpoints
corner wrapping and backwards steps are adjacent; jail jumps are not
identical snapshots and unrelated UI changes emit nothing
money effects use only the confirmed delta and never alter balances
purchase effect waits for confirmed ownership
hotel upgrades and downgrades preserve actual building counts
roll/landing events follow phase changes and exact stored dice
turn announcements do not replay on money or property updates
restart cancels effects rather than showing refunds or purchases
card, jail, mortgage and bankruptcy events are edge-triggered
two restarts sharing a millisecond still cancel the previous effects
confirmed trade log IDs and auction wins are not replayed
audio requires a gesture, obeys mute/volume, caps voices and disconnects
victory takes sound priority over simultaneous bankruptcy and transfers
actual exported landmark bounds stay below gameplay and outside its column at every tier
mountain ridges close without a seam, remain distant and have four atmospheric depths
new cloud banks are deterministic, bounded and leave the under-board column empty
actual exported GLBs have valid buffers, geometry, textured PBR, applied origins and bounded cost
foundation generation receipt matches the actual artifact bytes and geometry
completed world manifest matches the shipped asset bytes and geometry
supporting kingdoms match their Blender receipts, topology budgets and waterfall anchors
a malformed GLB header is rejected
declared vertex bounds must match the actual binary positions
out-of-range triangle indices are rejected
external texture URLs cannot silently escape the self-contained GLB contract
a structurally valid all-black PNG is rejected before browser integration
background layout is deterministic and does not consume gameplay randomness
valley surface stays well below the board across its whole footprint
castles, villages and waterways remain outside the playable board
quality tiers have explicit bounded budgets and retain scenery at low quality
foreground apron is lower while the rear landscape height is preserved
terrain opens toward the foreground with a continuous, feathered inner rim
clouds leave open air below the board in every quality tier
live reduced-motion and visibility changes stop even an already queued frame

the menu entry graph excludes all gameplay renderers, assets, rules and WebGL packages
explicit Solo and verified-match modules retain the existing real 3D engine
the decorative menu image is a compact local JPEG, independent of game assets
HTTP envelope parsing accepts data and masks internal messages and non-JSON outages
authorized 401 refreshes once and resends the exact action body
a second 401 is surfaced without an infinite refresh loop
restore and concurrent refresh use CSRF bootstrap before a single cookie rotation
failed refresh clears memory authentication; profile failure cannot leave restore spinning
offline logout clears local tokens, survives reload and defers cookie revocation safely
UUID mapping preserves server seats, tokens, ownership, bankruptcy and dice across reordered arrays
online scene has only presentation controls, without Solo commands or future decks

uncertain actions block double clicks and manual retry reuses the complete original request
